column1: This workbook is an editorial and source-risk triage, not a completed peer review of 96 historical arguments.

column3: Frozen archive used for all page and link counts.

column2: Parsed titles, H1s, descriptions, canonicals, local links, tables, SVGs and visible source sections.
column3: Script-heavy content may be undercounted as visible prose.

column2: Estimated bibliography entries from visible Sources/References sections and counted live external links.
column3: A visible bibliography does not prove claim-level support or source quality.

column2: Flagged categorical, causal, priority/origin, institutional and quantitative central claims.
column3: Risk means verification priority, not falsehood.

column2: TF-IDF similarity plus editorial cluster review.
column3: Shared vocabulary can inflate similarity; each proposed merge needs human review.

column2: Keep, Revise, Hold, Split or Merge based on role, source visibility, risk and overlap.
column3: Decisions remain provisional until factual and specialist review.

column2: Full primary-source re-performance, legal opinion, community consultation, image-rights clearance and discipline-specific peer review.
column3: These are publication gates, not optional polish.
